data.title: Birmingham vs Bolton Prediction 28 Nov: AI Says Birmingham
data.content:
Birmingham are 4th and unbeaten at St Andrew's. They have won four and drawn one of their last five home league games, scoring 14 and conceding 3. They also won 2-0 at Burnley on Wednesday. Bolton are 19th and have conceded 33 goals in 17 games, including 1-3 at home to West Brom on Wednesday. Their injury list is long: Erhahon, Hardie, McAtee, Nelson and Toal. The search results mention Klarer returning from suspension. They also point to a doubt over Laird. [...] Birmingham's strong home scoring and defence are the main driver, alongside Bolton's leaky defence and lengthy injury list. Bolton's better recent away form and Birmingham's four home draws temper confidence, while the suspension of Cochrane and the return of Klarer are mild disruptions rather than decisive ones.

data.title: Birmingham City vs Bolton Wanderers Preview 11/28/2026 | Forebet
data.content:
Marc Leonard remains out with an Achilles injury, while Kristoffer Lund is not expected to feature. Taylor Gardner-Hickman was on the bench in midweek and should not be treated as unavailable. Klarer missed the Burnley game through a one-match yellow-card suspension, but he is expected to return, with Dael Fry likely to drop out despite helping Blues to a clean sheet at Turf Moor. Solís returned in midfield at Burnley, while Osayi-Samuel and Vicente strengthened the right side in that 4-2-3-1 [...] Bolton are still dealing with a sizeable injury list, with Jayden Nelson, Eoin Toal, Ryan Hardie, John McAtee and Ethan Erhahon all unlikely to be involved. Schumacher used Theo Bair from the start against West Brom, but Dalby came on at half-time and is the stronger candidate to lead the line here. Rodrigues also has a strong case to return behind the striker after his midweek impact, while Iling-Junior and Larrazabal offer width in the familiar 4-2-3-1 shape. [...] Bolton Wanderers
